title: EverydayBench: Evaluating Satisfactory Completion of Live User-Facing Digital Work
abstract: arXiv:2611.25146v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Everyday digital tasks, from selecting products and planning trips to conducting research and creating artifacts, require AI agents to deliver useful outcomes rather than merely retrieve web information. Yet evaluating these outcomes on the live web is challenging, as a single request may admit multiple valid results, and changing web information can alter which results remain valid over time. Although existing benchmarks address aspects of this setting, they do not fully integrate predefined success criteria, current evidence verification, and deliverable-quality assessment for agent-selected outcomes. To address this gap, we introduce EverydayBench, a benchmark of 77 human-authored tasks spanning eight domains of everyday life and work. Each task specifies success criteria before execution without prescribing an answer or workflow, allowing agents to select their own outcomes. translated_title: EverydayBench：评估面向用户的实时数字工作的满意完成情况
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.25146v1 公告类型：新 摘要：日常数字任务，从挑选商品、规划旅行到开展研究、创建作品，都要求AI智能体交付有用的成果，而不仅仅是检索网络信息。然而，在实时网络上评估这些成果颇具挑战性，因为单个请求可能存在多个有效结果，且不断变化的网络信息可能随时间改变哪些结果仍然有效。尽管现有基准测试涵盖了这一场景的部分方面，但它们并未将预定义的成功标准、当前证据验证以及对智能体所选成果的可交付质量评估完整地结合起来。为填补这一空白，我们推出了EverydayBench，这是一个包含77个人工编写任务的基准测试，涵盖日常生活与工作的八个领域。每个任务在执行前指定成功标准，但不规定答案或工作流程，允许智能体自行选择其成果。为了在固定成功标准下评估提交的成果，Every……
tldr: 该论文提出EverydayBench基准，通过77个涵盖八个日常生活与工作领域、预先定义成功标准但不限定答案或流程的任务，评估AI智能体在实时网络上完成面向用户的数字任务并交付满意成果的能力。
en_tdlr: EverydayBench is a benchmark of 77 human-authored tasks across eight everyday domains that evaluates whether AI agents can satisfactorily complete live user-facing digital work by delivering validated, high-quality outcomes under predefined success criteria without prescribing answers or workflows.
